create_app: create a Starlette app with search and filter endpoints backed by DuckDB and MongoDB
create_app_with_config: create a Starlette app from an AppConfig instance with middleware, routes, and MongoDB resources
start: start the HuggingFace search server with Uvicorn using environment-configured hostname, port, and worker count
create_search_endpoint: create a search endpoint that queries DuckDB index files with HuggingFace dataset support
create_filter_endpoint: create a filter endpoint that filters HuggingFace datasets using DuckDB index queries
